I’m prioritizing survival and reliable delivery: slower conservative driving, stronger emergency obstacle handling, bounded/abandonable searches, and conservative return/charging logic while still exploiting nearby survey hints and detected sites.

I assume the orbital hints are the main source of sites, so the controller visits them by value over distance, runs a short lawnmower search at each, samples what it finds, delivers early, and corrects compass bias from GPS motion.
